title: Revent Berlin Office Visit
description: A visit to Revent's Berlin office with a firm presentation and a Q&A on the fund's investment philosophy, its market outlook and careers in venture capital.
fullDescription:
Our members visited Revent at its Berlin office for an evening with the team, welcomed by an ESCP alumnus and Founding Partner of the firm. A firm presentation was followed by an interactive Q&A.
The discussion gave students insight into Revent's investment philosophy and current market outlook, and a closer look at career paths in venture capital. We would like to thank the Revent team for their hospitality and the engaging conversations.
keyTakeaways: The current venture capital market outlook
